Name: La Loggia Hotel
Company description: Boasting a bar with refreshing cocktails and an exciting wine list, shared lounge, garden and free WiFi, La Loggia Diffused Hotel is situated in Labin, a short drive from Šeničina Beach. Featuring family rooms, this property also provides guests with amazing and relaxing vistas from its seaview terrace while also providing city vibes and good company in it's historic 16th century Loggia. The accommodation features evening entertainment and a 24-hour front desk. The rooms are fitted with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a fridge, a shower, a hairdryer and a desk. At the hotel rooms are fitted with a wardrobe and a private bathroom. Guests at La Loggia Diffused Hotel can enjoy a continental buffet breakfast and will soon feature international cooked items such as eggs benedict, spanish omlette and a full english breakfast. The area is popular for hiking, cycling, snorkeling and diving, wine and food tours The nearest airport is Pula, 39 km from La Loggia Diffused Hotel, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.
